question: As of March 2023, who among the following is the Union Jal Shakti Minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gajendra Singh Shekhawat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gajendra Singh Shekhawat** is the Union Jal Shakti Minister as of March 2023.
 
• The Ministry of Jal Shakti was formed in May 2019 by merging two ministries: the Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation and the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation.
 
• Gajendra Singh Shekhawat has been serving as the Union Minister of Jal Shakti sin
